title: Nexus ListPatternsQuery
description: Query parameters for GET /v1/daemon/patterns (cursor-based pagination, `package_dir` ascending as UTF-8 bytes). No `sort` parameter is exposed.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned by the previous response's `pagination.next_cursor`. Clients MUST NOT parse it. It addresses one `package_dir` in a listing ordered by that field compared as UTF-8 bytes, which is the order the reader sorts in on every host — never a locale-dependent collation.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return, defaulting to 100. The ceiling is 200: one listing page of local packages that a UI can render as a list. A value outside 1–200 is a typed 400, never a silently clamped page.
